newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN SIGN FRENCH INTERNATIONAL LIZARAZU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN SIGN FRENCH INTERNATIONAL LIZARAZU.

text.p: German champions Bayern Munich signed French international defender Bixente Lizarazu on Monday from Spanish club Athletic Bilbao.
Bayern said Lizarazu, 27, had signed a four-year contract. He is expected to slot into the left wing-back position vacated by Christian Ziege, who left Bayern for AC Milan at the end of last season.
Media reports differed on the size of the transfer fee for the 35-times capped player, with estimates ranging from seven million to eleven million marks ($4 million to $6.3 million).
